title: Linguistic Productivity in Large Language Models: Models Coerce, but do not Preempt
abstract: arXiv:2606.02953v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Usage-based theories of grammar explain language users' ability to interpret and produce novel combinations of words through two complementary inferential strategies. In cases of coercion, a language user, when encountering a word that is mismatched to its grammatical context, reinterprets that word in a way that resolves the conflict. In cases of preemption, the user infers that an otherwise plausible structure is unavailable or dispreferred because it fails to occur in contexts where it would be expected. Large Language Models are also usage-based, in the sense that the structures of language are learned through exposure to vast amounts of text. translated_title: 大型语言模型中的语言能产性：模型会进行强制解读，但不会进行先占推断
translated_abstract: 基于用法的语法理论通过两种互补的推理策略来解释语言使用者理解和产出新颖词语组合的能力。在强制解读的情形中，当语言使用者遇到与其语法语境不匹配的词时，会以化解冲突的方式对该词进行重新解读。在先占的情形中，使用者会推断某一原本合理的结构不可用或不受偏好，因为它没有出现在预期会出现该结构的语境中。大型语言模型同样基于用法，因为语言结构是通过接触海量文本而习得的。本文检验强制与先占这两种相反的力量是否同样在大型语言模型中促进并约束语言能产性。我们在多种规模和架构的模型上证明，较大的模型在强制解读的情形中能够识别构式的能产性，即使……
tldr: 该研究发现大型语言模型具备促进语言能产性的“强制解读”推理能力，但缺乏人类语言使用者用来约束能产性的“先占”机制。
en_tdlr: This study finds that large language models exhibit the coercion-based inferential strategy that supports linguistic productivity, but lack the preemption mechanism that constrains productivity in human language users.
